Subject: Re: Fwd: Production latency + 5xx spike — propose geo-swap to us-east-1 (runbook + ETA)

Ava / team — initial telemetry from the node fleet shows elevated GPU scheduler contention and an increased retransmit rate on the us-west-2 EFA fabric starting ~07:40 PST. This aligns with the customer’s window.

Recommended immediate mitigation (executing now):
1) Disable region-preferred routing for Northforge at the load-balancer layer (roll back to global routing policy).
2) Enable geo-swap to us-east-1 with staged cutover (10% -> 50% -> 100%) to avoid cold-cache amplification.
3) Warm KV cache by replaying hot prefixes for the top 50 keys (script attached).
4) Increase batching window by 10ms for 15 minutes to reduce request amplification while we stabilize.

Estimated timeline:
- 0–5m: disable region-preferred routing + start 10% diversion
- 5–20m: monitor error rate and latency, ramp to 50% if 5xx < 2%
- 20–35m: full diversion if stable

I’m attaching the runbook and a packet capture sample. Rafael — you’ll need to coordinate the routing-policy change and ensure the rollback path is tested before each ramp. I’ll monitor metrics and open the incident doc: https://drive.redwood.com/incident/NF-2026-11-20-geo-swap

Attachments: runbook-geo-swap.md, packet-capture.zip, timeline-20261120.csv

Customer impact: ~36 minutes of elevated error/latency window (07:40–08:16 PST) with partial recovery during ramp.

Recommended commercial remedy: 10% service credit for the impacted invoice month + a joint post-incident review with the customer (we’ll deliver a technical RCA within 72 hours).
